factsheet.heading: History
paragraphs: The Old Fire Station is a vibrant community building in the heart of Stoke Newington and is home to a number of charities and not-for-profit groups and organisations that provide services for the benefit the local people of Hackney. It is also a place where local people can run and attend community classes and events, and somewhere for you to host a children’s party, family gathering or special event. It has been a community centre since 1982

factsheet.heading: Community open afternoon
paragraphs: Get to know more about what goes on here at our amazing, grassroots community building that served as a working Firestation from 1886 until the late 1970's and opened as a community centre in 1982 after local campaigning.
All ages welcome, there will be music and games, tasty-pay what you can- seasonal food and drink as well as informal, behind the scenes building tours, and archive materials on display.

We’ll have live music from Jah Prophecies Soundsystem in the yard, and taster activities including Jewellery Making with Creativity in our Hands, and upcycling and costume design with Jamboulay Carnival Arts
Find out more about our history of firefighting and beyond -and what's happening now including the new community darkroom space - and become part of our story!

factsheet.heading: Informal building tours
paragraphs: We will be running impromptu building tours during the course of the event; please note this will be over a number of different levels, including one narrow staircase; as there are some uneven flooring surfaces, please wear sensible footwear ( no high heels)
